name: Stein Eriksen Lodge Deer Valley
insider_take: This Norwegian-inspired alpine masterpiece sits at 8,200 feet elevation, offering ski-in/ski-out access to some of America's most exclusive slopes where deer literally roam the perfectly groomed runs.
whats_special: Named after Olympic ski champion Stein Eriksen, this luxury lodge features authentic Scandinavian architecture with hand-carved woodwork and stone fireplaces. Deer Valley is the only resort in the US that limits skier numbers daily and prohibits snowboarders, ensuring uncrowded, pristine conditions. The lodge's location in Silver Lake Village puts you steps from the Sterling Express lift.
pro_tip: Book spa treatments for après-ski – the lodge's spa uses locally-sourced botanicals, and the outdoor hot tub offers stunning mountain views while soaking tired muscles.
dont_miss: The complimentary ski valets who handle your equipment, the lodge's famous chocolate chip cookies served warm each afternoon, and sunset cocktails at the Troll Hallen Lounge with panoramic views of the Wasatch Mountains. In summer, the alpine slide and scenic chairlift rides reveal wildflower meadows and wildlife spotting opportunities.
pros: Ski-in/ski-out access to world-class Deer Valley slopes
Authentic Norwegian alpine architecture and design
Award-winning spa with comprehensive wellness facilities
Multiple dining venues including fine dining restaurant
cons: Mountain location requires transportation to Park City
